knowledge_gaps: Temporal inputs are unresolved: log2feats(sequence) receives only item IDs, and diagnosis batches provide neither users nor timestamps. Repeated items and identical sequences can have different time gaps, so item-ID lookup cannot reliably reconstruct them. Confirm that the pinned predictor supplies aligned historical timestamps before implementing decay.

The decay mechanism lacks timestamp units, missing-value handling, gap normalization, rate initialization and truncation rules. Decay between historical events also cannot measure inactivity after the final event without an observed prediction timestamp.

BPR-max lacks concrete negative-pool sizes, regularization coefficients, sampling replacement rules and loss-reduction details. Excluding every training-history item can remove a valid repeated-item positive from eligibility unless positive supervision and negative filtering are handled separately.

No baseline validation scores or measured runtimes support the proposed four-way ablation budget or the numerical potential and difficulty ratings. Mean cosine near zero also cannot establish that embeddings avoid low-rank collapse.

follow_up_queries.reason: Resolve whether temporal conditioning is implementable under the sequence-only interface and define reproducible time handling. If aligned timestamps are unavailable at inference, prioritize the BPR-max-only GRU trial.
follow_up_queries.query: For time-aware GRU sequential recommendation, including 2Gated-TimeGRU, how are per-occurrence historical timestamps aligned with truncated, left-padded item sequences during training and inference? Can elapsed-time decay be computed from item IDs alone when items repeat, and what timestamp units, missing-gap policies, normalization and decay initialization are documented?

follow_up_queries.reason: Specify the loss and sampler precisely enough to reproduce the experiment while avoiding false-negative and repeated-item errors.
follow_up_queries.query: In the official GRU4Rec implementation of Recurrent Neural Networks with Top-k Gains for Session-based Recommendations, what are the exact BPR-max negative-score regularization formula, default coefficient, negative-pool construction, duplicate handling and loss reduction? How should these be adapted to per-position training with user-history exclusions and repeated positive items?

follow_up_queries.reason: Strengthen validation interpretation and budget planning before assigning high expected impact to the combined model.
follow_up_queries.query: What evaluation guidance addresses repeated hyperparameter selection with fixed sampled-negative HR@10, paired uncertainty estimates for the same validation users and candidates, and runtime-bounded ablations in sequential recommendation? Consider four categories with 200 users each, 99 fixed negatives per user, one training seed and macro-average HR@10.
